description_en: Queries the operation logs of a data synchronization link for a specified ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询指定RDS实例数据同步链路的操作日志
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-replication-link-logs --db-instance-id pgm-bp1trqb4p1xd0000 --task-type create --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeReplicationLinkLogs

parameters.help_en: The task ID. The task ID returned when you call the CreateReplicationLink operation to create a disaster recovery instance
parameters.help_zh: 任务 ID。调用CreateReplicationLink接口创建灾备实例时返回的任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The task name. The task name returned when you call the CreateReplicationLink operation to create a disaster recovery instance
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称。调用CreateReplicationLink接口创建灾备实例是的任务名称
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en:
The task type. Valid values:
create: Create a replication link.
create-dryrun: Dry run for creating a replication link
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。
create：创建同步链路。
create-dryrun：创建同步链路预检查
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records per page
parameters.name: page_size

ReplicationInfo.description_en: The synchronization information. This is a reserved field

ReplicationState.description_en:
The synchronization status. Valid values:

steaming: Synchronizing.
finish: Completed.
disconnect: Disconnected
ReplicationState.description_zh:
同步状态。

steaming：同步中。
finish：完成。
disconnect：断开
